notes: Customer: large regional health system, multiple hospitals + research arm. Sensitive PHI; HIPAA primary driver.
Main ask: Private VPC deployment with full audit trail exported to their Splunk + SIEM.
SIEM export: must support both CEF over TLS and JSON over HTTPS (Splunk HEC). Real-time forwarder desirable; batch S3 export as fallback.

Log schema requirements (security): request_id, timestamp (RFC3339), tenant_id, user_id (hashed), role, session_id, model_id, model_version, input_hash (SHA256), output_token_count, latency_ms, status_code, error_code, config_snapshot, kv_cache_hit, deployment_node, region, request_size_bytes.
PII constraints: no raw PHI in logs. Customer requires input redaction controls and a flag showing if content was redacted; hashed identifiers only.
Retention: security/legal asked for 6 years for audit logs (HIPAA), but operational access logs can be 1 year; need a retention matrix per log type. Confirm retention + delete APIs.

Access logs: admin console actions (model rollouts, canary switches, key rotations), API key events, token usage breakdown per request, and KMS crypto operations must be logged with key_id and rotation events.

KMS: customer uses AWS KMS with a customer-managed CMK (multi-account). They require envelope encryption and proof that Redwood will not persist unencrypted key material. Also want HSM attestation or compatibility with CloudHSM for private key ops.
Audit trail integrity: security wants immutable append-only logs, tamper-evidence (hash chains) or signed exports on rotation. They requested example signed-export workflow.
SLOs: latency p95 target <50ms for short-chat path; need evidence of batching not breaking latency SLO and how logs capture degraded fallback events.
Redwood ask: provided sample log schema at drive:/samples/log-schema/larkspur-audit-schema-v1.json and a checklist for SIEM integration (syslog/CEF + HEC endpoints).
Quote from CISO: "We must be able to demonstrate end-to-end visibility for any PHI-accessing call and maintain an immutable audit trail for six years."
Quote from Head of Infra: "If Redwood can plug into our Splunk HEC and show KMS CMK integration with key rotation logs, we fast-track pilot."

POC notes: want a 4-week POC in their VPC with a dedicated small GPU pool; week 1 infra + SIEM hookup, week 2 run synthetic EHR queries, week 3 run load + token accounting, week 4 security signoff and runbook handoff.
Immediate blockers: legal wording for KMS responsibilities, sample signed audit export, SIEM schema finalization.
